newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady on a live basis, compared with Monday's close, USDA said.
Trade was fairly slow and demand light to moderate. Seller interest light. Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1125-1275 lbs 63.00-64.00 ld 62.00 Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1025-1175 lbs 63.00-64.25 2 ld 62.00.
Most cattle delivered to packing plants with weighing conditions equivalent to 3 percent shrink at feedlots with some being bought on a picked up (FOB) basis.
